title: Customers with orders and total
statement_markdown: Write a query to find information based on customers, orders.
hints: Review the problem statement and expected output.
reference_solution: SELECT c.name, c.region, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS total_orders_amount FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.region ORDER BY total_orders_amount DESC
